name: nf-annual-rates
description: Establish selected Norfolk Island ordinary rates and annual waste charges for 2026-27 using the adopted council resolution and applied legislation. Use for residential, farmland, accommodation and business property, valuation, vacant-land discounts, instalments, pensioner concessions or rating objections. Includes category boundaries, amount-in-dollar tables, fictional calculations, separate review clocks and source checks. Separates the importer waste levy, approved service fees and historical absentee levy from annual property charges. Preserves actual assessment, current amendments, interest authority, relief and procedure gates, together with universal workflow outputs. This source-cited reference does not complete the property or country pack.
